debugData.name: Showcase wetlands terrain
debugData.description: terrainShowcase's wetlands (p310 §3.5): mud01 (the base), mud02 (the channel, its banks and the hollows), grass02 (the raised ground) and rocks01 (the path and the bunker's pad) weighed by the block's COLOR_0 (RGB_AO, the AO on indirect light) through the height blend, DUAL_SCALE, the sets as one array (ARRAY storage: the quality tiers sample in slots), and wet: puddles on ground flatter than 8° in patches (the macro noise's B at 20 m), rain ripples, and the regional wetness of the block's _WETNESS attribute (the default _wetness: three's GLTFLoader lowercases it), so the channel and the hollows stay wet in any weather; snow (snow01) and frost; and the rain occlusion map (MAP), so the ground inside the bunker's doorway stays dry in the rain.
